name: WdContentControlLevel
description: Specifies the possible levels for a content control, returned by the ContentControl.Level property.

constants.name: wdContentControlLevelInline
constants.description: Represents a content control that surrounds content within a single paragraph.

constants.name: wdContentControlLevelParagraph
constants.description: Represents a content control that surrounds one or more complete paragraphs.

constants.name: wdContentControlLevelRow
constants.description: Represents a content control that surrounds a table row.

constants.name: wdContentControlLevelCell
constants.description: Represents a content control that surrounds a table cell.
